policies.display_name: Baseline - Device Password Policy (Consolidated)
policies.source_file: 02_Windows_CIS_Benchmark_Hardening/Baseline - Device Password Policy (Consolidated).json

framework.auditor_notes: Consolidates the 6 separate 'Device Password Enabled...' policies from the original baseline into one. The DeviceLock CSP requires all child settings (min length, complexity, lockout, inactivity, history) to travel together under one parent setting — deploying the original 6 as separate policies to the same device causes a genuine Intune Settings Catalog conflict, since each file reset the others' settings back to schema defaults. Fixed 2026-09: min length 14, alphanumeric required, 5 failed attempts, 15 min inactivity, 24-password history, enabled.
